items.prompt: A modeled 5-octet send accepted 2 octets, then would block. What remains?

options.text: The final 3 octets, with offset still 2
options.why: The accepted prefix must not be duplicated.

options.text: All 5 octets, because would-block undoes prior progress
options.why: Prior accepted progress is not rolled back.

options.text: Nothing, because any successful send delivers the entire message
options.why: The return count says only 2 were accepted.
No remote business acknowledgement was received.

items.explanation: Keep progress across calls and retry only the unsent suffix after readiness/deadline policy permits.
